repair: Omit data_key when it is None, matching Qlib DatasetH semantics, and add a regression test with a delegate that rejects explicit None.
recovery: Reuse the already counted CCC candidate evaluation, count one uniquely identified replacement wf_2018 fit, then execute the remaining registered fits and the Gate candidate.

budget_change.reason: One failed pre-training implementation-harness fit remains permanently counted; no model outcome was observed.

non_changes: same seed, folds, deterministic refits and hyperparameters
same data, market-state product, costs, benchmark and screen thresholds
failure_rule: Any further failed fit is retained and terminates M7; no second replacement is authorized.
